title: GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline
description:
## Goal

Land the GPU side of the `gf2-sim` pipeline: HIP host
infrastructure, deterministic ChaCha20 + AWGN GPU kernel, LDPC
belief-propagation batch decode kernel, Gray-QAM soft-demap
integration, OOM auto-fallback and kernel hard-fail handling,
and the GPU-vs-CPU byte-identity harness.

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Runs in parallel with
the CPU foundation story (lockstep handoff via the Phase 0
design doc `ec530af9`). Kernels live in the existing crate
`gf2-kernels-hip`; the host-side dispatcher lives in `gf2-sim`
behind feature `hip`.

## Deliverables (themes)

- HIP host infrastructure: stream pool, allocator wrappers,
  deterministic-launch helpers, multi-arch dispatch shim
  (gfx1030 today; gfx1100 / gfx1200 / MI seams documented).
- GPU ChaCha20 + Box-Muller AWGN producing the same byte stream
  as the host ChaCha20 partitioning.
- LDPC BP batch decode kernel (DVB-T2 n=64800; designed for
  per-`i_LS` 5G NR shift tables).
- Gray-QAM soft-demap GPU integration (wraps existing
  `demap_batch`).
- OOM auto-fallback to CPU stage; kernel / driver hard-fail
  with diagnostic dump.
- Byte-identity harness comparing CPU-only vs CPU+GPU paths
  for `fer` / `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` on the DVB-T2
  chain.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] GPU-vs-CPU byte-identity property test passes on the
  DVB-T2 chain at a fixed seed.
- [hard] Receipt artefact under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/gpu-stages-receipts.md` records
  per-kernel throughput on gfx1030 + the byte-identity
  attestation.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the HIP dispatch model and
  multi-arch target list.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals; multi-GPU implementation is out
of scope (seams only).
